releaseNotes.zh-CN:
- 隐藏应用列表顶部新增说明，帮助理解勾选后对其他应用的可见性。
- 改善授权自动刷新与恢复，减少长时间未打开管理端后 SIM 等功能失效的情况。
releaseNotes.en:
- Added an explanation at the top of the hidden apps list to clarify how selected apps are hidden from other apps.
- Improved automatic authorization renewal and recovery for SIM and other features when the manager has not been opened for a long time.
